notes.title: STORY - 3 - NARZALLAR
notes.content:
[h1][b]NARZALLAR PLANET[/b][/h1]

Of all the planets, Narzallar was certainly one of the richest in minerals. Thousands of years of mineral deposits have transformed the fauna living there into those that feed entirely on minerals. They were so attached to their mines that they believed that even if they knew what was going on in the universe, the mines would save them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/47d2668fde63a357ba69ae67296916a3ba8cd688.png[/img]

Yes, indeed, the mines had a magic. They could make any living thing dependent on them. But was it magic or desire? Planets are falling apart, Chaos is taking them over one by one, but the inhabitants only care about their own wealth. It was such a passion that no matter what they faced, this place was theirs and they would never give it up. They were locals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/98deae761cea8146a762318e0ba6d077741178f5.png[/img]

[h1][b] THEY HAD TO CHOOSE SIDES [/b][/h1]

But no matter what they did, they could never escape the evil of Chaos. Completely possessed by Chaos, the creatures were now just pawns. They went into the deep... They have to go deeper for Chaos. All the wealth and power of the Narzallar's was now in the hands of Chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/a2eee2be776674dc1b99cac130600005180aa996.png[/img]

The Mothership had gathered all this intelligence and knew what was going on there. They had not interfered with the creatures living here, but they had seen their struggle with Chaos. Now there was only one thing to do. Mecha droids to land here and cleanse this planet once and for all. It was not going to be an easy task. But it had to be done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/d1456895d2215d5312d816b361bded09ddf9d49c.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/54M89Hs774][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/7486a84e26e0ad3141a61c8b18ea3fca5de5877c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: STORY - 2 - HETUNE
notes.content:
[h1][b]HETUNE PLANET[/b][/h1]

The planet Hetune was an excellent resource planet before it was discovered. It was a planet of natural colors, inhabited by flying creatures and many different types of deposits. A colony was established on this planet many years ago to develop our technology. The colony had its own ecosystem. There was both production and the extraction of underground resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/f069e9e7405cce0611ce4c1b317d03b591dd7de9.png[/img]

Apart from the rich underground resources, this planet reminded many planets of the past with its air and orange soil. Many technological tools were produced and tested here. Spaceships, land vehicles, attack vehicles with automatic enemy detection technologies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/0dac25f2b45e28061b633a98372b52ab9a10a8cc.png[/img]

[h1][b]IN THE PALMS OF EVIL[/b][/h1]

Chaos had smelled this place and realized the importance of this point in the vast universe. Although the planet's production power was very high, its defense power was almost non-existent. This led to a catastrophe. All the employees were dead. There was not a single vehicle left for them to escape, they were all destroyed. All the refineries were now in the hands of evil. The technology here had evolved in chaos. The control center was completely taken over. The radio stations were no longer working and all the materials extracted were now in the hands of chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/7c854db4e6eb37c983cd3dc5eaef7a139e345a88.png[/img]

The gravity of the situation was revealed after a long time when a small group was sent there. Now all the vehicles there had been taken over, reconfigured with artificial intelligence and completely taken over by the chaos side. In this way, chaos created its own mecha race.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/093ff8d7bd7c12afcce9553ab74aebf3535fc88a.png[/img]

notes.title: DEVBLOG - 2 - MOTHERSHIP
notes.content:
[h1]MOTHERSHIP[/h1]

The last remaining bastion of humanity. All existing technology is centered on this mother ship. The Guardians are also manufactured here. Armed with superior technology, the mothership is our greatest power against the chaos race. Since we cannot settle on any planet, this is our homeland. 

Our mothership contains many features. We need to send the materials that fall from all the races we destroy by landing on the planets to our ship. Our mothership helps our mechadroids with the signals given by the players and sends us a drop pod. It allows us to carry all the materials we collect to our mother ship with the help of this drop pod. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/6453e8e9d57be8da0c2fb1f5627df65dcdc732d1.png[/img]

At the same time, our mothership has a large collider within itself to process these materials. Thanks to this technology, it allows us to transform many materials found on planets and obtain different new technologies. These materials not only give us new technologies but also different powers. Humanity's dependence on these materials is a necessity in that world. It is essential for the production and survival of the mother ship and the entire crew. 

Apart from all these, our most important power that we need to continue to produce in order to land on planets is our mechadroids. These are currently produced in 3 types. They are also given special names by the crew, Hunter, Warlock, Titan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/a5960f8b33264848ddf25ce4ba81b0c0a6e99546.png[/img]

[h1]CRAFTING[/h1]

Hunter stands out with his agility and the plasma weapon he uses. Warlock, on the other hand, can use more technological spells with the materials used. Titan, on the other hand, has the power of melee attack among mechadroids and is at the forefront with its defense features. 

The strengthening of our mechadroids is also done in our homeland. We can improve their new features with the materials we collect. At the same time, the crew, which uses different technologies to make permanent improvements, prepares new skill trees for different mechadroids according to their own characteristics. As a result, the Chaos Race never stands still in its power. Humanity must develop for this power that is constantly expanding and taking over and devouring planets one by one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/98c3af5232c7717f032c8923d43639f46e2a8213.png[/img]

notes.title: STORY - 1 - ZENDORIA
notes.content:
[h1][b]ZENDORIA PLANET[/b][/h1]

Zendoria planet is an exotic and interesting world with unique features. The surface of the planet consists of vast and predatory plains. In addition to these plains, there are steep cliffs, huge mountains, and wide deserts. The fauna of the planet is also quite rich and diverse. Wild creatures, land and water creatures, huge flying creatures, and wild plants are among the common creatures found on Zendoria planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/5a22bf5dee612a8f3ab23dcd0b93102a110d6a7f.png[/img]
Zendoria planet has a hot and arid climate. During the day, the temperatures are high, but the air cools at night. Therefore, the temperature difference between day and night is quite high. Due to the dense atmosphere of the planet, the sky can appear reddish during the day.

[h1][b]The spread of CHAOS[/b][/h1]
Chaos has taken Zendoria with all its might. Now this planet is entirely in the hands of the [b][u]Drakenari[/u][/b] race. Fate is up to you.

The gladiator race living on this planet is famous for its strong and courageous warriors. This terrain is an ideal place for gladiators to showcase their powers and skills. The gladiator race has a human-like structure. Their bodies are muscular and strong, they have long necks, and broad shoulders. Their eyes are large and bright, and their dark hair is straight and tough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/726affa204fa7c12d244415e8f9a03b9f0defeb9.png[/img]

On Zendoria planet, the gladiator race fights not only in arenas where they compete against each other, but also against harsh and dangerous natural conditions. Their traditions are based on strength and courage as well as loyalty and honesty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/66b832af1645165577ffeff0d8374641b68e96f3.png[/img]

In conclusion, Zendoria planet is a world filled with a strong, courageous, and talented gladiator race. The surface features, harsh and challenging conditions, colorful sky, and rich fauna offer a unique experience for visitors. Death Chamber is located at the heart of the Zendoria.

After reaching the planet Zendoria, all communication regarding the planet has been cut off. The goal of the Guardians project is to collect chaos shards in order to cleanse the planet from Chaos monsters and continue the project as well as other planets in the system.

notes.title: DEVBLOG - 1 - GUARDIANS
notes.content:
[h1]WHAT IS GUARDIANS?[/h1]
Welcome to [b]Guardians[/b], an extraordinary multiplayer / co-op rogue-lite survivor game that transports you to a captivating universe teeming with danger, discovery, and heroism. Immerse yourself in a sprawling, post-apocalyptic world where chaos-infected creatures roam, and the fate of civilization rests on your shoulders.

As a guardian mecha droid, you embody the last line of defense against the encroaching darkness. Prepare to unleash your unique powers, wield formidable weapons, and master devastating abilities as you embark on an epic quest to restore balance and vanquish the forces of chaos.

[h1]UNLEASH THE POWER WITHIN[/h1]
Immerse yourself in Guardians, an extraordinary action role-playing game where you harness the power of a guardian mecha droid to battle against the forces of chaos. Engage in heart-pounding combat, unleash devastating abilities, and wield formidable weapons as you become the last line of defense against the encroaching darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/937e425c3c0a0b3751428a6f7704bdea101da8a7.png[/img]

[h1]A VAST AND CAPTIVATING UNIVERSE[/h1]
Explore a sprawling, post-apocalyptic world filled with breathtaking landscapes, from lush forests to haunting ruins. Each planet holds unique ecosystems, hidden secrets, and treacherous challenges, offering endless possibilities for discovery and adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/2aeffa3bacbca19e7bbb08747496e65de2591426.png[/img]

[h1]EPIC BATTLES AND HEROIC BOSSES[/h1]
Prepare for intense encounters against hordes of ferocious creatures and colossal bosses. Master a diverse array of combat skills, strategically chaining powerful attacks, evasive maneuvers, and devastating combos. Rise to the challenge and prove your skills in exhilarating cooperative battles or intense PvP showdowns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/a678f2636e4de2494a1fc6af48fc056b25402321.png[/img]

[h1]PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS[/h1]
Guardians can now be played online by lobbying from within the game. It's time to join forces with your friends against this relentless enemy and save the planets from chaos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302318/6862c7223c643fddfc98037d47a774d397bce9e6.png[/img]
